title: Hard-task bake-off v1: runtime components against verified completion
summary: 32 hard Rust tasks (20 development, 12 held out) through the real CLI with independent hidden-acceptance verification; staged component isolation, interactions, ablations and held-out confirmation with gpt-5.4-nano (partial: OpenAI credits ran out), claude-haiku-5-5, Gemma 4 and a gpt-5.5 reference; lifecycle faults at five boundaries.
limitations: one task family size per area; three trials per cell for the primary models, one for Gemma
the primary weak model changed mid-run (credits exhausted); records are never pooled across models or endpoints
claude-haiku-5-5 is near the suite's ceiling
one task (ledger-split-preserve) has an ambiguous goal about where to add a test

reproduce.command: cd bench/bakeoff && python3 -m bakeoff run --plan plans/<plan>.json --out <file> (real models opt-in; scripted plans offline)

comparability: Matched comparisons within one model and endpoint only; not comparable with agent-bench rates.
